source: NpcTemplate.calculateDrops(DropType.DROP, victim, killer) (calculateGroupDrops, calculateUngroupedDrops, calculateGroupDrop, calculateUngroupedDrop)
note: The input of every case in drops_monsters.json, drops_raids.json and drops_rates.json. 'npcs': the drop lists the NPC loader left (NpcData: items that do not exist removed, 'drops' sorted by chance high to low, the items of each group sorted low to high, groups in document order), items as [item id, min, max, chance]; is_raid is the victim's isRaid(). 'items': every item the lists use and its hasExImmediateEffect(). 'profiles': the RatesConfig values of each rate profile (floats are Java floats, the per item maps are [item id, value]); 'bonus_killer' says the killer has the bonus drop stats (the case's 'killer' block has the multipliers PlayerStat returned). 'scripts': the scripted draws.

profiles.name: shipped
profiles.note: Rates.ini as shipped (all multipliers 1, the per item maps 57,1;... and 21747,0;...)

profiles.name: x1_empty_maps
profiles.note: all multipliers 1 and no per item map (the Java defaults)

profiles.name: rates_x5
profiles.note: death chance x5 amount x3, raid chance x2 amount x4, herb chance x3 amount x2, no per item map

profiles.name: rates_fractional
profiles.note: chance 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.7 and amount 2.5 / 1.5 / 0.5 (a Java float widened to double is not the decimal number)

profiles.name: by_id_high
profiles.note: per item maps: adena chance 200 (capped to 100) amount 3.5, herb 8600 chance 2.5 amount 2, 1867 chance 4 amount 1.25, 17 amount 0.5; death chance x2

profiles.name: by_id_low
profiles.note: per item maps: adena chance 0.5, herb 8600 chance 0 (never drops), 1867 chance 1 (exactly 1: the x1 path), amount of 57 0.25

profiles.name: occurrences_1_3
profiles.note: shipped rates, at most 1 item (3 for raids) below 100 % chance

profiles.name: occurrences_0
profiles.note: shipped rates, DropMaxOccurrences 0 (the counter is 0 before the first item: nothing is rolled)

profiles.name: occurrences_5_20
profiles.note: shipped rates, at most 5 items (20 for raids)

profiles.name: occurrences_1_x5
profiles.note: rates_x5 with at most 1 item (3 for raids): the counter logic with custom rates

profiles.name: gaps_custom
profiles.note: shipped rates, adena gap 3..6 down to 30 %, item gap 2..4 down to 50 %

profiles.name: gaps_equal
profiles.note: shipped rates, min = max level difference (8 and 5): scaleToRange divides 0 by 0, the gap chance is NaN and no gap check ever rejects

profiles.name: bonus_killer
profiles.note: shipped rates, the killer has bonus drop rate +35 %, amount +20 %, adena +60 %

profiles.name: bonus_killer_x5
profiles.note: rates_x5 and the killer with bonus drop rate +35 %, amount +20 %, adena +60 %

scripts.zero: every draw 0.0: every level gap check passes, every chance succeeds, every count is the minimum
scripts.high: every draw 0.9999: level gap checks pass only at 100 %, only chances of 100 % or more succeed, every count is the maximum
scripts.cube2: u*u*u of java.util.Random(2).nextDouble() x 600: biased low, many drops succeed
scripts.cube3: u*u*u of java.util.Random(3).nextDouble() x 600: biased low
